body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Generates implementation code, configs, and tests from structured designs. Real implementations include Simulink Coder, SCADE, and Interface code generators. Generated code is traceable line-by-line to the design.

title: Automated Engineering Code Generator — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Automated Engineering Code Generator — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Generates implementation code, configs, and tests from structured designs.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Automated Engineering Code Generator, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (State-machine to C/PLC code). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: State-machine to C/PLC code and Interface stub generation from IDLs. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Hardware description language compiler) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
